'''Zerot's Point''' was a rocky outcropping that rose above [[The Puddle]]. It was named after the first [[Zerot|man]] to set up a permanent settlement in that location. It had three [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] that overlooked the settlement and provided defense for the residents.<ref name="H&S" />
